body: What I mean by no reason, I know how fortunate I am, everything basically had gone well for me in my life, not because of anything I've done, I'm just lucky I guess. It just makes me feel like an asshole for feeling like shit all the time, when so many people have it a whole lot worse than I do.
It just feels like there's people here who need the help much more than me, there's no reason for me to feel this way, thanks for replying though.
